tips.summon: Welcome! Your Stronghold sits in the bottom-left corner. Drag a Miner (Grubgrabber Miner) from your hand onto a free space on your back row, the bottom row next to that corner, to summon it. You have no crystals, but a basic Miner is free when you are broke.
tips.move: Nice! Press Done to reach the Action phase, then drag your Miner onto an empty space beside the middle mine. Miners may move the turn they appear. Each troop does one thing per turn: move OR attack OR mine. You can zoom (pinch or mouse wheel) and drag the battlefield to look around, and tap any creature to see its card.
tips.mine: Mining is an action! On your next Action phase, drag your Miner onto the mine beside it. A Miner mines 2 crystals, a Fighter 1. Standing nearby without mining gives nothing.
tips.mineTap: Now the shortcut. Next turn, in the Action phase, tap the mine: every ready Miner beside it mines at once. Tap the mine now (press and hold a mine to see its info).
tips.spend: What you mined becomes your Flow at the start of your next turn. Spend your Flow: summon a Miner or another troop in the Deploy phase. (The tutorial tops up your Bank so you can keep playing.)
tips.crystal: Crystal cards fill your Bank. Bank crystals never reset and can be spent any time, even while the enemy acts. Play a Crystal card from your hand now.
tips.upgrade: Upgrade time! In the Deploy phase, drag a Miner card from your hand onto one of your own troops to upgrade it. A basic Miner gives +1 Health, a Smith Miner gives +1 Attack and +1 Health, for good.
tips.swap: Swap places: in the Action phase drag one of your troops onto another of yours (within its move range) to trade places.
tips.fight: Time to fight! In the Action phase drag your Boneknocker onto the enemy troop. A preview shows You deal and You take before you let go. Melee hits are simultaneous: both strike. Damage heals at the start of your next turn.
tips.spell: Cast a spell! Drag Venom Shiv from your hand onto an enemy troop: it is poisoned for 3 turns. Spells cost soul crystals (Flow first, then Bank). Tap a card's text for the Full explanation.
tips.savings: Saving up: if you end your turn with 10 or more Flow, every 10 Flow becomes 1 banked crystal. You have plenty of Flow right now, so just press Done and watch it get banked. After the enemy moves, open the Menu on the right and press Last turn to see what it did.
tips.commander: Finally, march a fighter next to the enemy Stronghold and attack the Commander. Each hit removes Health equal to the attacker's Attack. Bring them to 0!
